Method of Attack: Phishing scam via fraudulent domains impersonating MetaMask
Stealing wallet seed phrases through fake MetaMask browser extension installation pages
Emptying victims' cryptocurrency wallets after obtaining seed phrases
Attack Vector: Google search ads and other search engine ads leading to fraudulent domains
Fake MetaMask phishing pages prompting users to import wallets and enter seed phrases
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing forms stealing wallet seed phrases
Fake MetaMask browser extension installation pages
